title: Field algebraic and cohomological Brauer comparison
statement: For every field K the Brauer equivalence classes of finite-dimensional central simple K-algebras are in bijection with H²(Spec(K)_et,G_m) [def-br].

proof.text: Apply the algebraic classification to identify Brauer classes with second continuous Galois cohomology of separable-closure units.
Apply the etale/Galois comparison and compose the two bijections. The Lean proof constructs Equiv.trans, without an additional hypothesis on K.
